one_line: Early Hoysala ruler from the Malnad hills who rose within the Western Chalukya world before Dorasamudra emerged as a major Hoysala centre.

appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard along the jaw, calm but alert eyes with a focused, confident expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a short warrior’s topknot at the back of the crown; front kept smooth with a slight centre part, framed by a simple gold circlet band resting low on the forehead
appearance.costume: era-accurate West‑coastal Karnataka royal-warrior attire: a fitted short-sleeved angarakha-style tunic in deep leaf-green cotton reaching mid-thigh, tied diagonally with a fabric tie; over it a sleeveless, waist-length quilted cloth vest in muted maroon with subtle vertical stitch lines suggesting light padding; lower body in cream-coloured cotton dhoti, wrapped from waist to ankles in a practical warrior’s kashta style with neat pleats at the front and slightly tapered at the calves; around his waist a broad dark-brown leather belt with a simple rectangular bronze buckle and an attached cloth sash in warm saffron tied to the left, its end hanging to knee level; over one shoulder a soft off-white cotton uttariya (upper cloth) draped from right shoulder across the chest and over the left arm, leaving the tunic visible but suggesting readiness to be wrapped tighter in travel; feet in brown leather sandals with ankle straps; minimal but dignified jewellery: small round gold stud earrings, a single medium-thickness gold neck torc close to the collarbone, and a pair of plain gold bangles on each wrist to echo Hoysala royal restraint; no heavy armour, but a narrow bronzed armguard strapped on his left forearm to hint battlefield readiness and Western Chalukya influence.
appearance.signature: A medium-length, slightly curved single-edged sword in a plain brown leather scabbard, worn at his left hip; the hilt has a simple disc pommel and short crossguard in dull bronze, with a wrapped dark cloth grip, evoking an early Hoysala martial emblem without turning the weapon into ornate fantasy.

ref_desc: Vinayaditya Hoysaladeva is a sturdy, medium-brown warrior-king with black topknot, gold circlet, green tunic, maroon vest, cream dhoti, saffron sash, leather belt and sandals, simple gold jewellery, and a curved bronze-hilt sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style model of Vinayaditya Hoysaladeva, an early Hoysala ruler from Karnataka: a sturdy, medium-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, sharp jawline, straight nose, calm intense eyes, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard. His thick black hair is gathered into a short topknot at the back of the crown, the front smooth with a slight centre part, and he wears a simple gold circlet low on his forehead. Show him in era-accurate Malnad–Western Chalukya royal-warrior dress: a fitted short-sleeved leaf-green angarakha-style tunic to mid-thigh, over which sits a waist-length sleeveless maroon quilted cloth vest with subtle vertical stitching. His lower body is wrapped in a cream dhoti in a practical warrior kashta, pleated neatly at the front and tapering at the calves, with a broad dark-brown leather belt and rectangular bronze buckle at the waist, and a warm saffron cloth sash tied to the left and hanging to his knee. An off-white cotton uttariya is draped from right shoulder across the chest and over his left arm. Show plain brown leather sandals with ankle straps, a narrow bronzed armguard on his left forearm, small round gold stud earrings, a single close-fitting gold neck torc, and simple gold bangles on each wrist. At his left hip, clearly visible, is his signature medium-length slightly curved single-edged sword in a brown leather scabbard, with a dull bronze disc pommel, short crossguard, and dark wrapped hilt. Use a palette dominated by leaf green, maroon, cream, saffron, and dark brown, and pose him in a neutral stance suitable for consistent redrawing as a character reference sheet.
